methodNote: Conservative import of records whose Zeno source taxonomy and/or downloaded-image audit clearly supports participation in the Chinese-style square-hole cash tradition. Mixed round-hole/openwork categories and unresolved visual groups remain outside this stage. Zeno IDs are ExternalRecords, not proof of unique physical specimens. Stage-1 also includes Zeno category #796 as a square-hole cash-tradition source group under the existing disputed sr21 family; the Zeno Western Liao/Yelü Dashi attribution is preserved as one competing attribution, not canonicalized.
